integrity: The claim is proved algebraically from the published update rule. A finite floating-point replay was used only as a consistency check and is not treated as proof. Literature comparisons distinguish the practical residual-ratio estimator from the source paper’s spectral-radius oracle and from gradient-difference adaptive methods.
limitations: Exact only for the practical \(l=1\) residual-ratio rule on SPD quadratics with exactly the two eigenvalues \(\mu\) and \(1\) and exact top-eigenvalue normalization; no claim is made for interior spectra, \(l>1\), inaccurate scaling, noise, nonlinear objectives, or momentum variants.
title: Exact alternating identification on two-endpoint spectra
